fieldValues.title: Memory stats are watched on a schedule and feed the dream's rules
fieldValues.move: The usage hook also records each srs-context call's duration and result size. Each dream writes one stats line (speed, reads per record, never-read, suspect, behind, brief tokens, citations) and compares it with the last; a rule whose measure worsens is flagged in the report. A stats view in srs-context shows the trend for a person and for an agent.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: It does not judge answer quality; that stays with the A/B bench run at the monthly review.
fieldValues.falsifier: Two dream cycles pass with a stat worse than its threshold and no rule change, retirement or finding citing it.
